name: application-loaders
title: Loaders
description: Loading indicators — spinners, dot animations, and inline progress bars — for communicating async operation states.
useWhen: An async operation (data fetch, form submit, file upload) is in progress and the user must wait.
Replacing a button label with an inline spinner while a form submission is processing.
Filling a content area while data loads to prevent a flash of empty state.
avoidWhen: The operation completes in under 300ms — showing a loader then removing it immediately causes visual flicker.
Precise numeric progress is available — use a progress bar with a percentage rather than a generic spinner.
The entire page is loading — use a skeleton screen instead of a centered spinner over blank content.
responsiveBehavior: Loaders are inline or overlay elements that adapt to their container size. Ensure overlay spinners are centered within their bounded region at all viewport sizes.
accessibility: Loading regions must include role="status" and aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce the loading state.
Spinners are purely visual — provide a visually-hidden text label such as 'Loading…' for screen reader users.
When loading completes, announce the result (e.g., 'Data loaded' or the count of results) via the live region.

variants.title: Spinner
variants.description: Minimal circular spinning indicator for full-section or page-level loading states.
accessibility: Add role="status" with a visually-hidden 'Loading…' text label inside the spinner element.

variants.title: Spinner (Dark)
variants.description: Circular spinner adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Spinner track and fill colors must maintain visibility against dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Spinner with text
variants.description: Centered spinner with a visible loading message below it, for section-level waits where a text label aids comprehension.
accessibility: Wrap in a role="status" container; the visible text already describes the state to screen readers.

variants.title: Spinner with text (Dark)
variants.description: Centered spinner with visible loading message adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dark spinner and label text must meet contrast requirements on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Spinner inline
variants.description: Compact horizontal spinner-and-text pair for embedding inside a button or inline within a sentence.
accessibility: When replacing a button label, keep the button disabled and announce 'Loading…' via aria-label.

variants.title: Spinner inline (Dark)
variants.description: Compact horizontal spinner-and-text adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Inline spinner must remain legible against dark button or text backgrounds.

variants.title: Progress bar
variants.description: Horizontal bar that fills left-to-right to show determinate loading progress as a percentage.
accessibility: Use a <progress> element with a value and max attribute for native accessible progress semantics.

variants.title: Progress bar (Dark)
variants.description: Horizontal progress bar adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Bar fill and track colors must provide sufficient contrast on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Dots pulse
variants.description: Three dots that fade in and out sequentially to create a pulsing loading rhythm, suitable for chat-style await states.
accessibility: Animated dots are decorative; a visually-hidden 'Loading…' label inside a role="status" container is required.

variants.title: Dots pulse (Dark)
variants.description: Sequential-pulse dot animation adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dot fill colors must contrast with dark backgrounds; visually-hidden label still required.

variants.title: Dots ping
variants.description: Three dots that expand outward with a ripple ping effect, for a more dynamic loading indicator.
accessibility: Animated dots are decorative; use a role="status" wrapper with a visually-hidden text label.

variants.title: Dots ping (Dark)
variants.description: Expanding-ripple dot animation adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Ripple colors must be visible against dark backgrounds; visually-hidden label still required.

variants.title: Dots bounce
variants.description: Three dots that bounce up and down in staggered sequence, for a playful loading indicator in lighter interfaces.
accessibility: Animated dots are decorative; use a role="status" wrapper with a visually-hidden text label.

variants.title: Dots bounce (Dark)
variants.description: Staggered-bounce dot animation adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Dot fill colors must contrast with dark backgrounds; visually-hidden label still required.
